description: A stereo delay effect built from a swarm of delay lines, each set to a different uncorrelated delay time

params.text: Takes the effect out of the signal path, so the input passes straight to the output
How many delay lines are in the swarm
How much of the voltage at the WORMHOLIZER CV input reaches the number of delay lines
How widely the delay lines are spread across the stereo field
How much of the voltage at the SPATIALIZER CV input reaches the stereo spread
How densely the delayed repeats fall in time
How much of the voltage at the TUNNELIZER CV input reaches the density of the repeats
The balance between the untreated signal and the effect

inputs.text: The left side of the stereo input
The right side of the stereo input
A trigger switches the bypass on and off
A voltage moving the number of delay lines
A voltage moving the stereo spread of the delay lines
A voltage moving the density of the repeats

outputs.text: The left side of the stereo output
The right side of the stereo output
